about: Pre-registered experiments for the nightly learning loop (engine/learn_loop.py, docs/LEARN_LOOP.md). Each is written BEFORE its first run, with its cut points picked on 2026 Jan-Jun only (h1_q = a quantile of the 2026 H1 trades). None is in docs/CLAUDE_REFERENCE.md 'Tested and rejected'. The loop runs one or two a night and NEVER adopts anything: a candidate goes to the owner + Claude. Add a row to queue a new idea; a changed rule is re-run from scratch.

gates.lit_tilt: LIT (CLAUDE.md LIT exception): tools/lit_edge.gate = more net $ in 2026 Jan-Jun (pick) AND Jul-Oct (check) at the LIT size AND on the live two_week eval path, 2-week fails not up in either half; 2-4 trades a week; at least 5 / 3 trades changed in the two halves; the same multipliers shuffled at random beat it in at most 20% of 200 draws per half. Costs in. 2021-25 is a reference line, never a gate. Eval speed (p10/f10, dec10, p15/f15, slow_pass, pass_med) stored with the $.
gates.atlas_tilt: ATLAS: tools/atlas_v2.verdict = better in 2026 Jan-Jun AND Jul-Oct (2-week pass not down, dead evals not up, eval-path $ up) AND 2025 + 2021-24 not losing (tier A) or not worse than today (tier B); 2+ signals a week in every span; at least 5 / 3 trades changed. Costs in, the owner's $43 25K price.

experiments.title: Zlarior x1.25 when dealer gamma is low (GEX bottom third)
experiments.hypothesis: With low / negative dealer gamma, dealers hedge with the move instead of against it, so a sweep-and-reverse travels further and the VIX-band target is reached more often. GEX has not been tested as a LIT size input.

experiments.title: Zlarior x0.75 the day after VIX jumped (VIX change top third)
experiments.hypothesis: A VIX jump the day before means a nervous tape: sweeps keep running instead of reversing. The VIX LEVEL was tested (rejected); the CHANGE was not.

experiments.title: Zlarior x1.25 after a tight Asia session (Asia range bottom third, in VIX moves)
experiments.hypothesis: A compressed Asia range stores liquidity on both sides; the London / NY sweep of it tends to start the day's expansion, so the reversal has room to run.

experiments.title: Zlarior x1.25 when the swept level was touched many times (touches top third)
experiments.hypothesis: A level that held many times collects more resting stops; its sweep is a cleaner stop run and a stronger turning point.

experiments.title: Zlarior x1.25 when the swept level is old (level age top third)
experiments.hypothesis: Old, untaken liquidity (days-old highs / lows) is the pool the big players aim for; taking it should mark a more important turn than a fresh intraday level.

experiments.title: Zlarior x1.25 when the entry fills fast after the CISD (wait bottom third)
experiments.hypothesis: A limit that fills within minutes of the change of character means price came straight back into the zone with force: the reversal is decisive. A slow fill is a drifting market.

experiments.title: ATLAS x1.25 after Zlarior was stopped out on the other side today
experiments.hypothesis: Zlarior's stop-out shows the move ran through its sweep level: an ATLAS trend entry in that direction rides confirmed flow. (The tested ideas were LIT winning the other side and same-side losses, not this.)

experiments.title: ATLAS x0.5 when a member already traded the other side today (two-way day)
experiments.hypothesis: Signals on both sides the same day mark a two-way, choppy session where trend entries give back; half size there protects the eval room. (The tested ideas were same-side retries and one signal per side, not this.)
